body:
TUNGSTEN files + full session report sent, per request ("finish and send latest to Tungsten mail rep as well and all targeted upgrades made"). Build: TUNGSTEN_10.62_A7.5_QUANT_SLS(148), compiles 0/0, deployed byte-identical to all 3 canonical locations.

This session had two parts. Part 1: 4 Prometheus+Sword campaigns targeting low-performing logic, 9 real fixes (WARRANT#157-165) -- indicator weighting, TP/SL execution, pattern learning, Kelly formula, ProbDB extrapolation, signal-quality gating, session/hour bucketing.

Part 2: activated a new standing charter, ARGUS (total-coverage audit, not sampling). It immediately found that CalculateKellyCeiling() -- WARRANT#160's own target, fixed hours earlier in Part 1 -- had ZERO call sites anywhere in the file. The fix was correct math; it had never executed. Same blast radius: a stranded peak-equity high-water mark, and a loss-cluster sentinel that genuinely detects breaks and prints "stake x0.XX" but never actually cut the stake, because its only consumer lived in the same dead function. Fixed same day: the function's internal early-return-bypasses-fade bug repaired, then wired into the real sizing pipeline as a pure terminal minimum (MathMin -- can only reduce risk, never raise it). Adversarial self-review ran a "sticky ratchet" hypothesis against the fix and it did not survive -- recorded as a failed hypothesis, not a finding.

Then did real ARGUS sector work: Sector 1, ~1923 of 2500 lines traced, no new defects at that scale, one more hypothesis formed and correctly refuted (an input-default vs. comment mismatch that turned out to be a later, authorized change, not a bug).

Full breakdown in the attached report. Honest status, not a completeness claim: ARGUS's own coverage ledger shows ~59,227 of 61,432 lines still UNREAD, zero sectors closed -- this is the opening of an indefinite standing audit. RepairWeakRegime's dead path remains deliberately unfixed (five prior live hangs). Nothing here is live-tested; the market hasn't been open since these shipped.
